<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Add and remove flags such as \\Seen, \\Flagged and keywords. Refs come from the arguments, or one per line on stdin when the only argument is -.

## Usage

```text
chainmail flags <ref>... [--add <flag>]... [--remove <flag>]... [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail flags cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 --add '\Flagged' --remove '\Seen'
chainmail flags cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 --add todo
```

## Flags

```text
      --add stringArray      a flag to add: \Seen, \Flagged, \Answered, \Draft or a keyword (repeatable)
      --remove stringArray   a flag to remove: \Seen, \Flagged, \Answered, \Draft or a keyword (repeatable)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
